selection_rule: Advance mechanisms with public evidence of a paid problem, existing DreamLedger capability, a bounded deliverable, and a defensible evidence trail. Do not activate externally without human authorization.

lanes.primitive: verify identity/authorization/claim -> collect evidence -> issue bounded verdict -> retain evidence receipt
lanes.evidence: NZ Government Procurement explicitly requires independent supplier due diligence and documented evidence; current commercial providers sell supplier verification as a service. citeturn0search3turn0search5
lanes.next_test: Define a $5 Supplier Verification Check contract: required input, source classes, PASS/FAIL/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict, evidence receipt, and fulfillment artifact. No external activation.

lanes.primitive: collect supplier inputs -> normalize price/terms -> reconcile differences -> produce attributable comparison artifact
lanes.evidence: NZ Government Procurement identifies supplier, price, competition, alternatives and market behaviour as procurement-analysis inputs; current procurement platforms expose structured quote comparison and evidence-backed supplier information. citeturn0search0turn0search13
lanes.next_test: Define a $49 Supplier Quote Comparison contract with fixed input schema, comparison fields, discrepancy rules, artifact schema, and evidence receipt. No external activation.

lanes.primitive: settled payment/authorized entitlement -> issue license identifier -> bind entitlement to deliverable -> retain issuance evidence
lanes.evidence: The mechanism is technically established, but this pass did not establish a sufficiently specific external buyer/problem/payment signal to justify adding integration work.
lanes.next_test: Do not build yet. Keep as slipstream reference until a concrete paid use case appears.

lanes.primitive: detect exception -> classify -> propose authorized action -> execute only when gated -> record outcome
lanes.evidence: Current products demonstrate commercial activity around exception detection and resolution, but DreamLedger does not yet have a mapped buyer, offer, price, and fulfillment boundary for this mechanism. citeturn0search9turn0search14
lanes.next_test: Search for a bounded, independently fulfillable exception-resolution job with an explicit buyer/payment surface before implementation.

proof_bound_commerce_anchor.rule: Payment observation never equals completed economic outcome. Verification requires attributable buyer evidence, settled payment, fulfillment, and independent proof.

hard_boundaries: No proprietary code or confidential implementation copying
No public outreach without human authorization
No revenue recognition from internal events
